{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "SQLite has three checkpoint subtypes: PASSIVE, FULL and RESTART.",
      "claim_text": "SQLite has three checkpoint subtypes: PASSIVE, FULL and RESTART.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S1."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Every checkpoint started with sqlite3_wal_checkpoint() or by the automatic mechanism is PASSIVE",
      "claim_text": "Every checkpoint started with sqlite3_wal_checkpoint() or by the automatic mechanism is PASSIVE.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S3", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Direct restatement of P5.S3."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "calling sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2() always produces a FULL or RESTART checkpoint",
      "claim_text": "Calling sqlite3_wal_checkpoint_v2() always produces a FULL or RESTART checkpoint.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S4", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S4 says FULL/RESTART can only be initiated by v2, not that v2 always produces them."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "A PASSIVE checkpoint is guaranteed to run to completion as long as no other connection is writing.",
      "claim_text": "A PASSIVE checkpoint is guaranteed to run to completion as long as no other connection is writing.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S2", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P5.S2 says PASSIVE might not complete with concurrent readers or writers."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a checkpoint can only reset the WAL when no other connection is using it",
      "claim_text": "A checkpoint can only reset the WAL when no other connection is using it.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P7.S1 states checkpoint can reset WAL only if no other connections use it."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a checkpoint will always reset the WAL whenever the WAL is unused",
      "claim_text": "A checkpoint will always reset the WAL whenever the WAL is unused.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "refutes"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P7.S1 gives only-if condition; unused WAL does not guarantee reset."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "The automatic checkpoint is implemented on top of sqlite3_wal_hook()",
      "claim_text": "The automatic checkpoint is implemented on top of sqlite3_wal_hook().",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S6", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P4.S6 states automatic checkpoint mechanism is a wrapper around sqlite3_wal_hook()."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "runs in the same thread as the COMMIT that pushes the WAL over its size limit",
      "claim_text": "The automatic checkpoint runs in the same thread as the COMMIT that pushes the WAL over its size limit.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P3.S1 states checkpoint run by same thread as COMMIT pushing WAL over limit."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "long-running readers never delay the automatic checkpoint",
      "claim_text": "Long-running readers never delay the automatic checkpoint.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P2.S0", "rel": "refutes"},
        {"sid": "P8.S0", "rel": "refutes"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P2.S0 and P8.S0 say long-running readers can prevent checkpoint progress."
    }
  ]
}
